author: Victor Eagle
text: Would suggest you use the libre 3 plus. The libre 2 is terrible as it only shows the readings when the alarm triggers. The libre 3 plus gives a continuous reading. Occasionally, the sensors can embed innacurate

author: Wendy Carothers
text: I asked my endo about this and he said the sensor is 15 or so minutes behind a finger poke.  And it will be about 10 points off. I'm usually 7 points difference most of the time. Luckily I'm great with maths
